name: devops-demand
title: DevOps Demand Management
description: Lightweight request workflow for the DEVOPS project: request forms (description templates), intake to Triage, P1/P2 escalation to the DevOps lead, Blocked/Done guards, aging flags, and a KPI dashboard widget.

widgets.name: DevOps Demand KPIs
widgets.description: Open demand, triage/in-progress/blocked counts, P1/P2, average age, aging distribution and blocked age for the DEVOPS project.
